final: WITH color_amounts AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_per_color FROM color_amounts), above_average AS (SELECT ca.invoiced_amount, ca.invoiced_amount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(invoiced_amount) FROM color_amounts) AS share_of_total, ca.invoiced_amount - s.average_per_color AS amount_above_average FROM color_amounts AS ca CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ca.invoiced_amount > s.average_per_color) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share, AVG(amount_above_average) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM above_average
